chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Hammad ibn Isa from 'Imran al-Halabi from Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him) said:
It is appropriate for the Mutamatti' (pilgrim performing Hajj al-Tamattu') to visit the House (Kaaba) on the Day of Sacrifice and from its night, and not to delay that day.

key_terms.لَيْلَتِهِ: Its night (the night before the Day of Sacrifice)
key_terms.لِلْمُتَمَتِّعِ: For the Mutamatti' (one who performs Hajj al-Tamattu')

ai.seo_question: When should a Mutamatti' pilgrim perform their visitation circumambulation?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-istibsar specifies the optimal window for Tawaf al-Ziyarah for the Mutamatti' pilgrim of Hajj al-Tamattu', emphasizing its performance on the Day of Sacrifice (Yawm al-Nahr) and the preceding night to ensure timely completion of Hajj rites. Scholars highlight this as a recommended (mustahabb) act that underscores the urgency of fulfilling the final pillar of Hajj before the days of Tashriq conclude, reflecting the practical discipline of the Shia fiqh regarding ritual timing.
